naming_voice: Concrete studio shorthand — a material, place or instrument noun, sometimes paired. Nothing cute, nothing trend-named ('neo-brutalist', 'glassmorphic'). Each name should survive being said out loud in a design review.
faceting: Every style carries derived `surfaces.devices` and `surfaces.artifacts` facets, computed from the artifact_type of its own source shots. Styles are split where the visual treatment genuinely differs between a marketing surface and a working UI; where a style transfers cleanly across both, it stays one style and the facets say so.

collections.name: Working Surfaces
collections.note: Light, dense, tool-like. Built for software people look at all day.

collections.name: Charged Neutral
collections.note: Desaturated grounds holding exactly one electric colour.

collections.name: Night Work
collections.note: Dark grounds. Light behaves as a material, not a background.

collections.name: Soft Weather
collections.note: Atmosphere, translucency and radius. Warmth without noise.

collections.name: Set in Type
collections.note: Type and image lead; the interface follows.

styles.name: Hairline Ledger
styles.concept: Rules, not boxes — density earns trust when every divider is 1px and every figure is tabular.

styles.name: Panel Stack
styles.concept: Work happens in panels — master list, detail drawer, kanban column — layered over a scrim instead of navigated away from.

styles.name: Canvas & Window
styles.concept: Float the product in a rounded window on a flat neutral stage so the interface is the only subject in frame.

styles.name: Ember Console
styles.concept: A single hot orange carries every chart series, CTA and alert across an otherwise white hairline shell.

styles.name: Grey Room
styles.concept: Drain every hue, then let luminance, letter-tracking and one black pill carry the entire hierarchy.

styles.name: Highlighter
styles.concept: Keep the page desaturated so a single chartreuse stroke reads as emphasis rather than decoration.

styles.name: Soft Render
styles.concept: Borderless pale fills and oversized light numerals, presented as a soft-focus 3D render in a grey studio.

styles.name: Paper Noir
styles.concept: Grained off-white pill geometry and solid black circular controls, photographed on a black set.

styles.name: Bloom
styles.concept: Colour arrives as light: feathered radial glow behind 1px-stroked cards on near-black.

styles.name: Dark Bench
styles.concept: Matte graphite tools on an infinite dotted canvas — one node in focus, the rest racked away.

styles.name: Cinema Glass
styles.concept: Full-bleed imagery seen through dark blurred glass, with chrome reduced to floating pills.

styles.name: Frosted Field
styles.concept: Carve every surface out of one pale gradient using translucency instead of borders or fills.

styles.name: Aura
styles.concept: Crisp white cards lifted off a soft coloured bloom — atmosphere with no texture at all.

styles.name: Soft Body
styles.concept: Large radii, soft shadows and barely-saturated pastels make dense data feel handled, not audited.

styles.name: Didone Signal
styles.concept: High-contrast serif display against tangerine and black pills — masthead grammar on a product page.

styles.name: Field Notes
styles.concept: Analytics dressed as a magazine: full-bleed landscape, serif headline, monospace figures inline in prose.

styles.name: Poster Block
styles.concept: Edge-to-edge colour bands and display caps — the page behaves like a printed poster, not a screen.

styles.name: Studio Object
styles.concept: A rendered object is the page; the interface shrinks to hairline pills docked around it.
